Warning.Description: Standard seats: Free for easyJet Plus cardholders and customers who have purchased a FLEXI fare. You choose where you want to sit - window, middle or aisle. Bring on board ONE small cabin bag (max 45 x 36 x 20 cm), which must fit under the seat in front of you. Please make sure you are aware of your baggage allowance. Details at easyJet.com.
Up front seats: Free for easyJet Plus cardholders and customers who have purchased a FLEXI fare. A seat in rows 2-6 (rows 2-5 on some aircraft). Details at easyJet.com.

Extra legroom seats: Free for easyJet Plus cardholders and discounted for customers who have purchased a FLEXI fare. A seat with extra legroom, plus all the other benefits of Up front seats. Details at easyJet.com.

Exit or Emergency row seats: Free for easyJet Plus cardholders and discounted for customers who have purchased a FLEXI fare. A seat with extra legroom, plus all the other benefits of Up front seats. Details at easyJet.com.

Exit or Emergency row seats are not available for infants, customers under 16 years, pregnant women, those who have hearing or sight disability, are mobility impaired, have an infant on lap, are elderly or fragile, or require a seat belt extension.
